observations: Two white desktop speakers with black drivers.
The 'logi' brand name is visible on the front of the left speaker.
The right speaker features a volume knob, a headphone jack, a power/Bluetooth button, and a lit blue LED.
A label on the back/bottom identifies the product as 'Z207 Rich Stereo Sound with Bluetooth'.
Model number 'S-00168' and 'Logitech Europe S.A.' are printed on the label.
A watermark 'DEALS MASTER GLOBAL LIMITED' appears across the photos.

claims.evidence: Photos only show the front and a small section of the label; the sides and back are not visible.
The blue LED indicates power, but there is no proof of button or knob functionality.
The adapter is not shown in any of the photos.
The UKCA mark on the label in photo 2 is consistent with the UK market but does not prove the item's history.
This is a keyboard-specific claim and is irrelevant for speakers, suggesting a generic or copied description.

risks.proof: A video clip of the speakers playing music at various volumes.
A video showing a device successfully pairing and playing audio via Bluetooth.
A photo of the included power adapter showing its specifications.

proof_requests: Video of the speakers playing audio via Bluetooth to confirm sound quality and connectivity.
Photos of the back and sides of both speaker units.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as Logitech Z207 speakers and is shown powered on. Although the seller's text includes irrelevant claims like 'no dead key', the item can be priced at its worst-case functional state.
